purpose: Egress allowlist and authority map of the Phase-1 governance audit. Only the documents listed under `audited` are extracted, and only their committed text may leave the machine. `role` says whether a source states policy of its own (`independent`) or routes to another source (`delegating`); a delegating source is never paired with the source it delegates to, and its classification holds only for the exact bytes in `classified_sha256`. Human-controlled policy input: see SOURCE_MAP.md.
